verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the workflow and regression tests remain correct. Both coverage-engine jobs now use the same rust-cache shared-key and omit the job-scoped key input, so the matrix partitions and merge job address one cache namespace while retaining the existing save-on-main policy. The tests inspect the actual top-level job bodies and rust-cache steps, require shared-key presence and equality, and reject key reintroduction; the targeted test class passes at the PR head. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue was found.
